game.chess.name: 国际象棋
game.chess.desc: 王者的经典游戏：出动子力、控制中心，并将死对方的王。完整规则涵盖王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变以及全部平局规则。
game.chess.rule.1: White moves first. Each piece has its own movement pattern; pawns promote on the last rank and the king may castle once with a rook.
game.chess.rule.2: Win by checkmating the enemy king. Stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition and the fifty-move rule are draws.
game.chess.option.castling_hint: 关闭后，王永远不能走两格，车也不能越过王。
game.chess.option.en_passant_hint: 刚刚前进两格的兵，可以像它只走了一格那样被吃掉。
game.chess.option.fifty_move_hint: 连续五十步未吃子、未走兵，对局即以平局结束。
game.chess.notation_hint: 点击棋子可查看其合法走法，然后点击高亮方格。吃子走法以红色标记。
game.chess.reason_stalemate: 逼和：无合法走法且未被将军。
game.chess.reason_insufficient_material: 平局：子力不足，无法将死对方。
game.chess.error.unknown_action: 该操作不属于国际象棋。
game.chess.error.illegal_move: 该走法在当前局面下不合法。
